summary: Miniature SPDT snap-action micro switch with a rectangular body, a hinged lever arm, three solder-tab pins on the bottom edge, and two mounting holes through the body thickness.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat broad body face (6.4 mm thickness, so ±3.2 mm from center). The two Ø2.4 mounting holes pass through it with a 9.5 mm spacing.
Bottom edge of the body, where the three solder-tab pins exit at x of about -8.1, 0.7 and 8.0 mm. The tabs have Ø1.6 holes and are 3.2 mm wide.

notes: Bounds are the body only: 20 x 6.4 x 10.2 mm from the drawing and product data. The lever (16.7 mm long, about 12 mm tip height from the hole axis line) and the pin tabs extend beyond this envelope and are not included. Hole x-positions come from the 5.25 mm and 9.5 mm dimensions. The hole z-position is estimated from the drawing's hole axis line and is approximate. The Ø2.4 holes are taken as through the 6.4 mm thickness because the drawing shows them in the front and back views.
